input.rationale: Section 9 contains only mutual corporate existence, authority, enforceability and non-conflict warranties (9(a)) and the Globix acknowledgment (9(b)). Nothing in Sections 1 (HDI's Responsibilities), 5 (Site; Site Management) or elsewhere warrants that the Site, software or hosting/development services will conform to documentation or perform to any standard, and there is no warranty duration or remedy; the fallback therefore fails on all four material terms. There is no \"AS IS\" clause or implied-warranty disclaimer, so no carve-out is required. We insert the missing express warranty as new Section 9(c). To clear the warranty-period requirement without ambiguity, every period is stated at or above 90 days: twelve (12) months for conformity of the Site and software to the applicable documentation and ninety (90) days for the services, with repair, replacement or refund of the fees paid as the remedy. The clause still sits at the fallback overall, as the preferred professional and workmanlike standard, compliance-with-laws warranty and no-malicious-code warranty are not sought.

proposal.summary: Insert Section 9(c): HDI conformance warranty for a period of twelve (12) months (Site/software) and ninety (90) days (services), with repair, replacement or refund of fees paid.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 warrants only corporate authority, so we have added HDI's express performance warranty as new Section 9(c): the Site and software conform to the applicable documentation for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery and the services are warranted for ninety (90) days, with repair, replacement or refund of the fees paid as our remedy. We can discuss shorter periods if HDI needs them.

ops.text: (c) HDI warrants that (1) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Site and any software delivered hereunder will conform in all material respects to the applicable documentation, and (2) for a period of ninety (90) days following performance, the services will be performed in conformity with this Agreement. For any breach of this warranty, HDI shall, at the Company's election, repair or replace the non-conforming software or services or refund the fees paid for the non-conforming software or services.
